summary.text: Sean Willcott is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 62 who has represented the district since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and owning a brewery.

paragraphs.text: Sean Willcott's career experience includes working as an engineer and owning a brewery.
He succeeded Randy Garber in the District 62 seat and took office on January 13, 2025.
He faces Jack Geiger in the general election.
